ns2:course.label: Aerospace Control Systems
ns2:course.description: Modeling of linear dynamic systems; Laplace transform techniques; linear feedback control systems; stability criteria; design techniques. Credit is not given toward graduation for AE 353 and either SE 320 or ME 340. Prerequisite: MATH 225, MATH 257, or MATH 415; and MATH 285 and TAM 212.
